name: auditpoppy
description: SOC 2 audit-readiness for your own AWS account, from inside your own AWS account.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/core lambdas && npm run typecheck -w @auditpoppy/desktop-sidecar && npm run typecheck -w @auditpoppy/desktop
scripts.test: npm run test -w @auditpoppy/core && npm run test -w @auditpoppy/desktop-sidecar && npm run test -w @auditpoppy/desktop
scripts.build: npm run build -w @auditpoppy/desktop && npm run build -w @auditpoppy/desktop-sidecar
